name: Typography and color tokens
description:
# Context

We are creating a shared Docusaurus theme for the Developers' portal. Figma is [here](https://www.figma.com/design/ZmSsc8dVmzloTI8jVFN1ur/Docusaurus?node-id=160-7121&t=h0iszn2LPRqYVW2J-1).

# Task

There is a basic token implementation based on our DS tokens. Docusaurus is using [Infima framework](https://infima.dev) assigned to custom Docusaurus tokens. Infima is not quite compatible with our Tokens see [Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/ZmSsc8dVmzloTI8jVFN1ur/Docusaurus?node-id=393-9748&t=h0iszn2LPRqYVW2J-4).

See [styleguide](https://www.figma.com/design/ZmSsc8dVmzloTI8jVFN1ur/Docusaurus?node-id=115-5180) and 

- ☐ Implement typography based on the Figma design 
- ☐ add tokens import
- ☐ And color tokens - assign tokens from the Admin Design System
